parameters.query: SELECT viewer.id AS viewer_id, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', m.id, 'at', DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(m.ended_at, m.scheduled_at), '%Y-%m-%d'),   'ball', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.match_rules, '$.ball_type')), 'innings', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.innings'),   'player_stats', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.player_stats'), 'potm', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.potm')))  FROM tournament_matches m JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = m.division_id  WHERE m.status = 'COMPLETED' AND m.live IS NOT NULL AND t.sport = $2 AND t.kind = $3) AS matches, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('m', ev.match_id, 's', ev.seq, 'type', ev.type, 'data', ev.data))  FROM match_events ev JOIN tournament_matches xm ON xm.id = ev.match_id JOIN tournaments xt ON xt.id = xm.tournament_id  WHERE xm.status = 'COMPLETED' AND xt.sport = 'CRICKET' AND $2 = 'CRICKET' AND xt.kind = $3  AND ev.type IN ('BALL', 'START_INNINGS', 'NEW_BOWLER', 'UNDO')) AS events, (SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(tm.id, tm.user_id) FROM team_members tm JOIN teams te ON te.id = tm.team_id  WHERE tm.user_id IS NOT NULL AND te.sport = $2) AS members, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', u.id, 'name', u.name, 'gender', u.gender,   'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birthdate, CURDATE()), 'block', u.block, 'district', u.district, 'city', u.city, 'photo_key', u.photo_key))  FROM app_users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT tm.user_id FROM team_members tm JOIN teams te ON te.id = tm.team_id  WHERE tm.user_id IS NOT NULL AND te.sport = $2)) AS users FROM app_users viewer WHERE viewer.phone = $1
